description:
x402 endpoint doctor: probes a paid x402 URL unpaid (never pays) and grades it A-F: 402 on GET / HEAD / empty POST, CORS, v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and v1 body, accepts (USDC asset, EIP-712 domain, Solana feePayer, amounts, payTo), multichain consistency and the Bazaar declaration. Free preview tier: grade, score, status and counts. The paid x402 endpoints /v1/lite ($0.005), /v1/check ($0.02, adds the facilitator validate verdict, payee checks and generated fixes) and /v1/site ($0.05, whole origin) return the fix list.

[x402Fix via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as x402Fix's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: lite $0.005 / check $0.02 / site $0.05 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

method.description: Method your paid route uses (default: from its Bazaar declaration, else GET)

tier.description: Paid tier: lite $0.005, check $0.02, site $0.05. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.

url.description: Full https URL of the paid x402 route (site tier: the origin or API base URL)
